documents.title: Statement on Academic Integrity and Use of Artificial Intelligence
documents.quality_note: Short university-wide statement: AI use only when faculty authorize; faculty to state expectations in syllabus.

notes: Searches of luc.edu found no CS department or school-level AI policy (CS pages describe AI minors only). Faculty Center slide deck 'Considerations for Generative AI Use' exists but is a workshop deck, not collected.
